newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dana says gets 86 pct of Petroceltic shares.
newsitem.headline: Dana says gets 86 pct of Petroceltic shares.

text.p: Dana Petroleum Plc said on Friday it had received valid acceptances for 7.5 million Petroceltic shares, representing 85.72 percent of the total shares, in response to its recommended offer for Petroceltic.

Dana said in a statement that it expected the new Dana shares to be admitted to the Official Lists of the London and Irish Stock Exchanges on November 18, 1996. The offer will then be declared unconditional in all respects, it said.

As a result of valid acceptances 16.8 million new Dana shares have been provisionally allotted to accepting Petroceltic shareholders, and up to a further 3.5 million new Dana shares will be allotted on completion of the offer, it said.
